# Original frontend attribution

The user supplied `Pension360_Fullstack_Project_v6_2.zip` for restoration of the existing interface. The frontend extracted from `Pension360_Integrated_v6_2/frontend` contains Horizon UI attribution and a consolidated third-party notice file. Both are retained byte-for-byte here:

- [Horizon UI MIT license](HORIZON_LICENSE.md).
- [Original frontend third-party notices](ORIGINAL_FRONTEND_THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt).

The consolidated original notice file covers the original project's dependency inventory. Its preservation does not mean every original dependency is installed in this Node edition. Use the current root `package-lock.json` and `docs/verification/dependency-inventory.json` for the shipped dependency inventory. Retain applicable attribution when redistributing the restored source and assets.
